next_experiment.central_question: Can the frozen Health Foundation runtime manufacture governed knowledge for another previously unseen Health product without new runtime logic or a new declarative semantic shape?

REUSE.rule: Existing generic contract, binder, certifier, semantic type, and governed spec schema already used before product selection handle the concept unchanged. New product-specific source/evidence records and new instances of those pre-existing schemas are allowed and expected. No new semantic/spec schema or declarative structural shape is introduced.
allowed_new_content: product-specific values, triggers, exceptions, scopes, relationships, and evidence attribution expressed through a pre-existing schema
tests that instantiate and exercise pre-existing generic contracts

CONFIG_SPEC.rule: Frozen generic runtime remains unchanged, but the product requires a new governed declarative semantic/spec structural shape not present before product selection. The new structure contains facts only and is interpreted by existing runtime without product-specific computation, branching, precedence execution, or executable decision logic.

REPRESENTATION_GAP.rule: Authoritative evidence is sufficient, but existing runtime and pre-existing declarative structures cannot represent the semantic shape faithfully. Certification must block during the frozen attempt and the gap must be recorded before any extension is designed.

KNOWLEDGE_GAP.rule: Reviewed authoritative/corroborating evidence is insufficient to determine the concept. Code and config must not compensate; the concept remains blocked.

anti_gaming_rules: New product-specific instances of an existing schema are not CONFIG_SPEC merely because a new file exists.
A newly invented declarative structural shape is CONFIG_SPEC even if it is encoded in JSON/YAML and requires no Python change.
Product-specific computation, branching, precedence execution, or executable decision tables in config are runtime-in-exile and fail the experiment.
A newly named generic-looking runtime abstraction created after product selection fails the initial frozen-runtime attempt.
Classification is based on repository state existing before product selection, not author intent.
No product may be selected because its target-concept wording appears easy, familiar, or likely to produce a favorable score.
No KNOWLEDGE_GAP may be converted to an absence, zero value, or non-application claim without affirmative evidence.

success_bar.STRONG_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN: Both target concepts are REUSE and all primary metrics remain zero.
success_bar.MINIMUM_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN: Both target concepts are scoreable as REUSE or CONFIG_SPEC, at least one is REUSE, no REPRESENTATION_GAP occurs, and all primary metrics remain zero.
success_bar.REPEATABILITY_NOT_PROVEN: Any primary metric is non-zero, any target concept is REPRESENTATION_GAP, or both scoreable concepts are CONFIG_SPEC with zero REUSE.
success_bar.REPEATABILITY_INCONCLUSIVE: At least one target concept is KNOWLEDGE_GAP and no architecture/repeatability failure otherwise occurs.
